about_the_game:
Step into the shoes of Ranman, a slightly clumsy but incredibly brave hero who accidentally unleashed powerful chaos upon his peaceful kingdom. Your mission is to traverse crazy worlds, filled with colorful platforms, dangerous traps, and bizarre enemies, to fix the damage and restore order.

Key Features:

  • Dynamic Levels: Jump, run, and overcome obstacles in meticulously designed levels that blend classic platforming with modern twists.

  • Crazy Power-Ups: Collect coins that grant Ranman special abilities, such as super jump, super damage, or super health.

  • Unique Enemies: Face hordes of foes, from classic creatures to giant bosses guarding each world.

  • Mysterious Secrets: Discover hidden passages, secret levels, and collect all the coins to unlock bonus content.

"Ranman" is the perfect choice for fans of classic platformers who love challenges but also want to have fun. Can you tame the chaos and become a true hero?

Ready for the adventure? Dive into Ranman's world and show that you can save the kingdom from total mayhem! 🎮✨

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux Ubuntu 18.04 (or equivalent)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or APPLE, AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7850 (at least 2 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 2048 MB available space
